item.title: FDA approves GSK's bepirovirsen (Hibsago) for chronic hepatitis B, offering functional cure
item.description: The U.S. Food and Drug Administration on Tuesday approved GSK's bepirovirsen, to be marketed as Hibsago, for the treatment of chronic hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection in adults without cirrhosis. The drug is the first antisense oligonucleotide approved for chronic hepatitis B and is indicated for…

item.title: Musk says exploring SpaceX-Tesla merger; special committees formed
item.description: Elon Musk said Tuesday that a merger between his two companies, SpaceX and Tesla, would be a "good idea," and that the boards of both firms have formed special committees to discuss a potential tie-up.
